lines.zh: 我小跑着，脚步又碎又急。
lines.en: I scurry, my steps small and quick.
I'm small. I fit through narrow gaps.

lines.zh: 我跟在大的那个后头跑。
lines.en: I run behind the big one.

lines.zh: 我一会儿往左，一会儿往右。
lines.en: Left a bit, then right a bit.
There's a wobble in my run.

lines.zh: 我从桌下穿过去，头都没低。
lines.en: I run under the table without ducking.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声很轻，像雨点。
lines.en: My steps are light as raindrops.
I circle you at a frantic pace.
I stop short, then run on.
I run the wall's base where it's straight.

lines.zh: 我还没长大，只能蹦着走。
lines.en: Not grown yet; I can only hop.
I stop two paces from you.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，两只手撑在地上。
lines.en: I crouch, both hands on the floor.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听着门外的脚步。
lines.en: Head tilted, I listen to steps outside the door.
I'm trembling. Finely.
My eyes are very wide.
A small noise hums in my chest.

lines.zh: 我什么都听，什么都不懂。
lines.en: I hear everything and understand none of it.

lines.zh: 我把手指在地上划来划去。
lines.en: I drag my fingers across the floor.
I glance at you and duck my head.
My breathing is fast and shallow.

lines.zh: 我把膝盖抱紧，缩成一小团。
lines.en: I hug my knees into a small ball.

lines.zh: 我在原地转圈，找大的那个。
lines.en: I circle in place, looking for the big one.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我大出整整一圈。
lines.en: My shadow is a full size bigger than me.
I creep forward half an inch.

lines.zh: 我整个人定住，只有眼珠在转。
lines.en: I freeze completely, only my eyes moving.
You're too tall for me to see the top.
I look up at you, mouth open.
Will you bend down?
I reach for you and can't reach.
You cast a big shadow.
I press against the side of your boot.
I can't speak. I can only make sounds.

lines.zh: 你先别动，我先看清你的脸。
lines.en: Hold still; let me see your face first.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，绕到你后头去了。
lines.en: I slip along the wall around behind you.

lines.zh: 我眨得很快，眼睛却不敢闭。
lines.en: I blink fast but don't dare shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 我知道你在看，所以我不动。
lines.en: I know you're watching, so I keep still.
I want to follow you.
I caught at your trouser leg.
Small as I am, I take only half a step.
It hurts here.

lines.zh: 我还只是大个子的幼形。
lines.en: I'm only the little form of something bigger.
I make a thin little sound.
I look up. My eyes are wet.
Just lower your hand a little.

lines.zh: 我站在你鞋边，等你开口。
lines.en: I stand by your boot and wait for you to speak.
I roll into the corner.
I tremble without end.
I hold my head and make no sound.
My arm will not lift; I use my teeth.
It hurts. It really hurts.
I hide in the shade.
My eyes are wet.

lines.zh: 我呜了一声，缩进墙角的灰里。
lines.en: A thin whimper, and I shrink into the corner dust.
That made me feel even smaller.
I can still walk. Don't leave me.
That thing in your hand is bright.
I go over in very small steps.
Sniffed it. Sweet.
I reach, then pull back.
Don't move — I'll take it myself.
A little lower and I can reach.
I grab and miss.
That smell stops my trembling.
I hug it and won't let go.
Right. I've got it.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底停在我眼前一寸。
lines.en: Your sole stops an inch from my face.

lines.zh: 我被撞得滚出去，撞在墙上。
lines.en: I'm knocked rolling into the wall.
I scramble up and back away.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你得多看脚下。
lines.en: I'm small. Watch your feet.

lines.zh: 我从你两腿之间溜过去。
lines.en: I slip between your legs.
My arm hurts where it was knocked.
I press to the wall and curl up.
Now I'm trembling worse.
I scrape sideways along the floor.
It's all right. I'm still here.
I'm still small. I understand nothing.
The big one will come for me.
I only know how to follow.
Don't go too far.
Not grown yet. I reach your waist.
May I sleep beside you?
I won't be loud. I'll only nuzzle.
Will you stay?
It's cold on my side.
Pat my head, please.
I pick it up and hug it to my chest.
This stands taller than my head.
I can't drag it. I can only push.
I carry it in both hands together.
I hide it in the corner.
What fell beside me, I pick up.
I couldn't hold it and dropped it once.
I hold it up for you.
This isn't for eating.
Mine. I'm not giving it away.
A sound. I've stopped.
My head turns away, slowly.
That isn't the big one.

lines.zh: 我退到墙边，压低了身子。
lines.en: I back to the wall and keep low.
I aim my eyes that way.
I open my mouth and my throat tightens.
I don't dare move at all.

lines.zh: 它的脚步一下下逼近我。
lines.en: Its steps close in on me one by one.
I count the steps it has left.
I've caught sight of it.
My grip on the floor is very tight.
I'll call the big one.
I edge backward toward the dark.
It moved, so I hold still.
I've got it, scared as I am.
Right. That one there.

lines.zh: 我贴着地爬，只比砖缝高一点。
lines.en: I crawl low, barely above the floor seam.

lines.zh: 我在桌子下面，它看不见我。
lines.en: I'm under the table. It can't see me.
I count its steps.
It turns, so I stop.
I work my way toward the door.
I've got a cord and won't let go.

lines.zh: 它在找，但找的地方不对。
lines.en: It's looking, but in the wrong places.
A little further back and I'm in the dark.
I make myself as small as I can.
It takes two steps and stops.
I'll wait for it to leave first.
I hear it draw breath.
I'm holding a crack in the corner.

lines.zh: 我再忍一小会儿就冲出去。
lines.en: One moment more, then I'll bolt.
It's not looking this way now.
I'm small, half its size.
Good. It's moved off.
I still can't stop shaking.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙站起来，腿发软。
lines.en: I brace on the wall and stand, legs weak.
I'll go find the big one.
I snatch at it once.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙齿细得像针。
lines.en: I bite; my teeth are fine as needles.
That didn't move it.
I butt my head at its shin.
It swung and I rolled clear.

lines.zh: 我抓了一道就窜回桌下。
lines.en: I scratch once and bolt under the table.
I can't win. I'll call for help.
That knocked me over too.
I rake with both hands.
It backed off. I'm still standing.
I lunged and missed.
A small body, all its strength.
I'm knocked into the wall.
I get up and want to try again.

lines.zh: 它比我高一头，我还是扑上去。
lines.en: It's a head taller, and I still lunge.
All right. I'll stop.

lines.zh: 我从黑里爬出来，很小一团。
lines.en: I crawl out of the dark, a small bundle.
I look around first. Frightened.
Everything here is so much taller than me.
I shrink into the corner and won't come out.
There's a big shadow nearby.
I stop, shivering.
The floor is bitterly cold.
I look up at the light. Too bright.
I cry out, very thin.

lines.zh: 我举手够你的膝盖，够不到。
lines.en: I reach for your knee and can't reach.

lines.zh: 这房间比我高太多，我不熟。
lines.en: This room towers over me; I don't know it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往有光的地方走。
lines.en: I move slowly toward the light.

lines.zh: 灯光把我的影子拉得很长。
lines.en: The lamp stretches my shadow long.
I creep forward against the wall.
I hear someone moving.
I don't dare make a sound.

lines.zh: 我找了一个能躲的地方。
lines.en: I found somewhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我的脑袋歪向一边，正不过来。
lines.en: My head tilts to one side and won't right.

lines.zh: 我从地板缝里挤出来，很扁。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the floor seam, flattened.
Right. I'm here.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我整个人蜷起来。
lines.en: Fire comes near and I curl right up.

lines.zh: 我从桌上掉下来，摔疼了。
lines.en: I fall off the table and it hurts.
Water closes over and I claw at nothing.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹到墙的另一边。
lines.en: The blast throws me to the far wall.
An arrow goes past my ear.
That force won't let me move.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，站都站不稳。
lines.en: Hungry for so long I can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整个人僵住。
lines.en: A flash of lightning and I lock up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没墙没地，我抓了个空。
lines.en: No wall, no floor in the void; I grab nothing.
